Tap the microphone beside the console\'s Send button to wake and keep listening; tap it again to end. With Jev judging on, Jev decides whether speech is for Xiao Bo and whether it\'s finished; other people\'s talk and anything unclear is only marked, not carried out. Off, or without a Jev key, every recognized sentence goes straight to the agent.

Tools and skills → Tool search uses this connection too. The recognized text (side talk included) and the last few exchanges are sent to Jev, about 2k input tokens per judgment, billed per call.

Say “OK Bothy”, or long-press Xiao Bo to wake it (when off, a long press puts Xiao Bo to rest)

Applies at once, no need to save. A small model on the device listens for the wake word all the time (about 4.6 MB, no audio uploaded). Once woken, Xiao Bo flies to the middle and opens its card, whose input box turns to voice; it ends after %1$d seconds idle or a tap on Collapse, then goes back to listening for the wake word. While operating the screen, what it hears is shown at the top of the screen and hidden in screenshots.
Accepts %1$s, even when not pronounced quite right
When on, recording uses the call audio source and the system cancels echo and suppresses noise.
This device has no system echo cancellation: voice stays half duplex and stops listening while the agent works and speaks.
Keep listening while speaking and working, so you can interrupt (needs echo cancellation)
Residual echo that matches the reply is dropped on the device; speech stops at once when Jev judges you are cutting in.

Run speech meant for the agent automatically and speak the reply
Uses the device\'s own text-to-speech; no key needed. For a more natural voice, add a Doubao Speech key on the Keys tab (recommended), then pick Doubao above.

Persona (edit and save to make it custom; the rules for handing tasks to Xiao Bo and ending the conversation are added after it)

For demos: after a wake, Doubao\'s end-to-end real-time voice (Seeduplex) listens and talks directly and answers small talk itself; for tasks it hands them to Xiao Bo (who stays silent) and tells you the result. When on, the wake and the microphone button both go this way, skipping speech recognition, Jev and Companion. It uses the Doubao Speech key in Settings → Voice → Keys, and end-to-end real-time voice must be enabled in the Doubao console.
No Doubao Speech key yet: add one in Settings → Voice → Keys first.
When off, Doubao can\'t hear you while it talks (so poor echo cancellation can\'t make it interrupt itself); say the wake word to interrupt. When on, you can just cut in.
Xiao Bo reads out late results

When off (the default), results Doubao can\'t wait for (past the wait, subagent and plan reports) only show on screen and are quietly passed to Doubao, so it knows when asked. When on, Xiao Bo reads them out once Doubao has finished talking.
